2. PRESENTATION OF PROPOSED AQUATICS FACILITIES
3. CONSENT CALENDAR
A. APRIL 1, 2010 Minutes
4. OLD BUSINESS
A. NEIGHBORHOOD TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PROGRAM � PROCESS AND FLOWCHART
SUMMARY
Over the last several months, the Traffic Commission has worked on the development of the Neighborhood Traffic Management Program (NTMP) including a toolbox and criteria for the installation of traffic calming measures. Staff has developed a flowchart and step by step guide that would be used to assist residents with the process.
Staff Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Traffic Commission review and comment on the Neighborhood Traffic Management Program process and flowchart.
B. REQUEST TO REVIEW TRAFFIC CONDITIONS AT 8510 AND 8470 EAST FERN AVENUE
SUMMARY
In April, the Traffic Commission received a request from C.P Cheung, Temple Intermediate School Principal and Rene Hernandez, Sanchez Elementary School Principal, to review traffic conditions adjacent to their schools. The Commission and staff agreed to make maintenance improvements during the school�s spring break (April 12-16) and further evaluate traffic conditions in the area. An inventory of the location has been completed and is included for further review.
Staff Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Traffic Commission take resident input on traffic conditions and identify specific traffic safety enhancements to pursue along Fern Avenue.
C. STREET NAME SIGNS DESIGN AND REPLACEMENT PROGRAM
SUMMARY
In accordance with Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) requirements, the City is required to develop a replacement program for existing street name and regulatory signs. The sign replacement program is aimed at meeting minimum reflectivity and lettering standards for all City-owned signs as required by the FHWA and the State of California�s Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD). The existing street name sign background color of yellow is not compliant with the State MUTCD regulations. The replacement program includes developing an inventory of existing signs, determining costs to replace these signs, and a creating a replacement plan and schedule for installing new signs.
Staff Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Traffic Commission provide staff with further direction related to street name signs.
5. NEW BUSINESS
A. GUIDELINES RELATED TO THE INSTALLATION OF PROTECTED/PERMISSIVE LEFT TURN
PHASING
SUMMARY
Over the last several months, the Traffic Commission has expressed interest in utilizing protected/permissive left turn phasing to help relieve traffic congestion at certain intersections. Without any specific guidance provided by the California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CA MUTCD), the City has been hesitant in recommending and/or analyzing such installations. Prior to moving forward with a pilot program for these types of left hand turn phases, a criteria is needed that will help determine when and what types of left turn operations should be used at existing and new traffic signal locations.
Staff Recommendation
Staff recommends that the Traffic Commission approve the draft criteria for the installation of left turn movements.
6. STAFF REPORTS
7. COMMISSIONER REPORTS
8. ADJOURNMENT

8838 East Valley Boulevard.
ROSEMEAD TRAFFIC COMMISSION May 6, 2010
